name: Tsukuyomi ~Marebito no Uta~
source:
Souma Shunsuke lives a peaceful life as a student, surrounded by girls like his childhood friend Kasumi and the energetic Judy.

But when the emerging religion <Tendo Zen> buys out the school, he and his friends are shrouded in a climate of unease. Along with this religious intervention comes a mysterious transfer student, as well as a board director and shrine maidens with an interest in Shunsuke, turning his life upside-down.

At the same time, due to the awakening of the ancient power "The Eyes of Rashin" inside of him, Shunsuke is able to wander the world of dreams. Through the dream world, he learns about the true aim of the religion, and the fate of the blood flowing through his veins. In order to unravel these mysteries, he will once again travel between the world of dreams and the real world...

Just what encounters, partings, and even miracles await him...?

[Translation of synopsis from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=8572&gc=gc]Getchu.com[/url]]
translation:
相马俊介过着平静的学生生活，身边有青梅竹马霞和精力充沛的Judy等女孩陪伴。

然而，新兴宗教“Tendo Zen”收购学校后，他与朋友们被不安气氛笼罩。伴随宗教势力介入而来的，还有一名神秘转学生、一名董事，以及对俊介表现出兴趣的巫女们，他的生活由此天翻地覆。

与此同时，俊介体内古老力量“Rashin之眼”觉醒，使他能够漫游梦境世界。通过梦境，他得知宗教的真正目的，以及流淌在自己血脉中的命运。为了揭开这些谜团，他将再次往返于梦境与现实之间…

究竟会有怎样的相遇、离别，乃至奇迹等待着他…？

[翻译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=8572&gc=gc]Getchu.com[/url]的简介]
